svg.title: Order of the Kustomize and Flux transformations the source mapping may learn
svg.desc: Four steps, none built, all decided on 2026-11-13. Step 1: namespace, from a namespace field in the kustomization file or from the Flux spec.targetNamespace; 46 percent of the surveyed Flux Kustomizations stop first on targetNamespace; the value is bound into the plan digest. Step 2: images, read as context; the fact that images are set is bound, not their content. Step 3: postBuild substitute and substituteFrom; 15 percent stop first here; allowed only when no substitution placeholder is in the identity fields of any document or in the edited scalar; only the reference list and the inline variable names are bound; no ConfigMap is read and the executor gets no grant. Step 4: configMapGenerator from local files and literals, which the real case that prompted the issue uses; secretGenerator never. Patches, components, Helm and remote bases stay refused. Every step still ends in the plan digest, the render check and a person merging the pull request.
svg.text: PROPOSED ORDER (NOTHING OF THIS IS BUILT)
Today the mapping reads plain manifests and resources lists only (ADR-0012).
read as context only, in the file
No action can change an image
patches (in Git or in Flux), components, Helm, remote bases, a name prefix or suffix, decryption, kubeConfig
Components and Helm are outside issue #166; the survey shows components as the first stop for 18% of Flux Kustomizations.
The model names only the target; the mapping decides the file; the render check runs on every commit; the plan digest is checked before every write; a person merges.
